limits: The host must provide an NVIDIA driver and an NVIDIA-enabled container runtime; neither the driver nor kernel is bundled.
Driver 550.54.15 is the migration policy for CUDA 12.4 Update 1, not an experimentally established minimum for every project workload.
Model weights and training checkpoints remain separate, hash-verified OSS assets.
Hardware changes require service correctness checks and CUDA extension rebuilds; historical performance is not portable.
